_comment: Copy this file to config.json (same folder) and fill in openalex.api_key. config.json is private: it is git-ignored and excluded from shared/return ZIPs. Precedence: CLI argument > config.json > built-in default. Empty strings mean 'use the default'. Relative cache_dir and venue_tiers paths are relative to this file. screening.admit_tiers lists the venue tiers admitted to the main corpus, e.g. ["A", "B"]; it needs screening.venue_tiers.
